<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex50222023-09-131" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">

         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4888">sher phyin gyi man ngag gi spyi khrigs laM gsal ba'i me tog</rs> ces bya ba zab pa'i don <lb edRef="inst:4887" n="6b4"/> bstan pa rdzogs s+ho || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4035">gnyan</rs> <note type="editorial">Tentatively identified as gNyan shes rab dpal (ID:4035), a teacher of mChims nam mkha' grags (ID:3977)</note> gyi dpe <choice><orig>la{s}</orig><reg>las</reg></choice> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4052">slob dpon chen po <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">snar thang</rs> pa brgyad par byon pa</rs>s <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4052">smon laM tshul khriMs</rs></note> bris de <choice><orig>la</orig><reg>las</reg></choice> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6458">btsun pa <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6458">ze'u</rs></note> chos kyi rgyal mtshan</rs> gyis bris shing zhus ste dag par byas pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
